offline_policy.vision_replay_success_rate_on_external16: NOT_MEASURED (no pre-recorded live Gemini Vision responses exist for External16 images; fabricated Vision responses are prohibited)
offline_policy.local_ocr_first_short_circuit_in_unified: In `unified_input.py`, `run_local_ocr_route` executes BEFORE `extract_problem_from_image`. When `rec['extraction_verified']` is True (`status='ready'`), `unified_input.py` returns immediately with `vlm_calls = 0`. When `not rec['low_quality']` (`uncertain_ratio <= 0.35`), `unified_input.py` returns `status='needs_confirmation'` with span-level `review_items` (`vlm_calls = 0`). Only when `rec['low_quality']` is True (e.g. cursive handwriting `uncertain_ratio = 0.5882 > 0.35`) or local OCR is unavailable does it invoke `extract_problem_from_image` (which fails closed with `VisionUnavailable` when `ALLOW_LIVE_AI=0`).
